shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in relief on an upright monolith
face with eyes and mouth rendered frontally at upper part of the surface
dense relief elements flanking the central face on both sides
low-relief surface carving covering a vertical slab
justification: Both surfaces depict a frontal anthropomorphic face/figure carved in relief on an upright block, with subsidiary carved elements flanking it symmetrically on either side, which is a moderately specific shared scheme. However, A shows an elaborate, fully detailed standing figure in ornate headdress and costume with a kneeling attendant below and profuse ornamental infill, while B shows only faint, sparse, schematic incised forms with no elaborated costume, headdress or accompanying figure, so the level of iconographic elaboration and the rendering conventions differ greatly.
